en.title: The Witcher 3 Remastered: 45GB PS5 Patch Drops September 29
en.summary: Prepare for a substantial download as CD Projekt Red confirms the massive update size for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt's next-gen remaster. Geralt's epic adventure is about to get a significant visual and gameplay overhaul.
en.body:
The wait is almost over for **The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt** players eager to experience Geralt's saga with a fresh coat of paint. CD Projekt Red has officially revealed the release date and, more notably, the substantial download size for the upcoming remaster. Mark your calendars for September 29, 2026, when the updated edition will become available across all major platforms.

For PlayStation 5 owners, the patch will be a hefty 45GB download, mirroring the size on Xbox Series X|S and PC. Nintendo Switch 2 users will face an even larger 50GB update, indicating the extensive nature of the enhancements. This isn't just a minor tweak; it's a comprehensive overhaul designed to bring one of the most beloved RPGs of all time up to modern visual and performance standards. The remastered version includes significant graphical improvements, gameplay enhancements, and importantly, all the content from the critically acclaimed **Hearts of Stone** and **Blood and Wine** expansions. For those who have poured hundreds of hours into the game, CD Projekt Red has confirmed that existing save files will carry over, allowing you to seamlessly continue your journey or revisit key moments with the new upgrades.

## A Monster Download for a Masterpiece

The sheer size of the update has naturally sparked discussion within the community. A 45GB download isn't uncommon for brand-new AAA releases, let alone a remaster. This figure underscores the depth of the technical and visual upgrades players can expect. Marcin Momot, a key figure at CD Projekt Red, confirmed the download sizes across platforms, alleviating some of the rampant speculation. The dedication to bringing **The Witcher 3** to its fullest potential on current-gen hardware is evident, promising a more immersive and visually stunning experience for everyone.

## What's Next for the Butcher of Blaviken

With the release date and download size now confirmed, the focus shifts to the launch itself. The **The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered** is set to go live on September 29, 2026, at 3:00 AM PT / 6:00 AM ET. This release is free for all owners of the game on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S, making it an incredible value proposition for existing fans and a perfect entry point for new players looking to dive into the rich world of the Continent.

content_raw: An update to current PS5 version. As a quick reminder, the newly remastered version of The Witcher 3 is an update to the current Complete Edition for the RPG, and that patch will be around 45GB in size. CD Projekt Red executive Marcin Momot revealed the download size of the update across all platforms in time for the weekend just gone, confirming PS5 and Xbox Series X|S players will have the same amount of data to download.
